[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53722/53722-1791689914-148714442.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I really like playing Stardew Valley on my phone. That to say, I really like a simple mod that doesn't do [/size][b][size=4]boom-boom DHUAR![/size][/b][size=3] (what's this? XD) But much more simple... like a character mod that doesn't really slap too much things on normal perfection clear. With that in mind, this is the mod I made for several month, bit by bit after my work hour. Sadly I don't really able to manage my time. And since the new patch 1.7 will come in future, I decide to let this mod have a little rest place to stay [/size][s][size=2]and keep that way till eternity.[/size][/s][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Meet [/size][size=5]Shelter and Side[/size][size=4] at their Little Corner! [/size][size=6] (☆ω☆)[/size][/b][/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Uh... they have a little store, maybe you interested on their wares?[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Though I can only say, it's not really a great selection ^^;;;;;[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It's mostly a mid game items. Maybe not very much needed anyway. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]So, in this mod....  (」°ロ°)」[/size]
- Shelter and Side have seasonal outfit (Yep! We need to see something fresh right? Rii...ght?)
- A simple event (but only three each) for befriending them. Yes you can marry them too //But you got a bug for this, please don't marry them //heh XD.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Simple food shop with some easy to make recipe. [s]Maybe.[/s][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Simple shop... you may find an endgame item like hopper! (not that you need, but my phone can't really handle automate, so this actually for me since I LOVE hopper :>)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- ........What else to say?[/color]


Shelter and Side is a very very very simple mod.
